name: emberfall-tavern
description: A D&D 5e (2024 SRD) campaign game with an AI Dungeon Master, AI companions, tactical grid combat and a growing town hub.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w packages/web && npm run build -w packages/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
